open-doors.title: The first regulars
open-doors.body: Your sport now has {{fans, number}} fans in {{country}}, including {{hardcore, number}} hardcore followers. Decide what to build around: a welcoming first experience, or a stronger routine for the regulars.

first-following.title: A following of your own
first-following.body: {{country}} has reached the first audience milestone: {{fans, number}} people follow your sport. It is a small foothold, but it belongs to you.

league-arrival.title: Put it on the fixture list
league-arrival.body: A league formed in {{country}} during the last turn. There are {{hardcore, number}} hardcore fans here now. Another place where your sport has a home.

moving-up.title: A bigger stage
moving-up.body: You promoted the league in {{country}}. Its current level is {{tier}}, backed by {{hardcore, number}} hardcore fans. That step is now part of your sport's story.

local-airtime.title: An audience worth reaching
local-airtime.body: {{country}} now has {{fans, number}} fans. You have enough of a following to decide how to reach more people: invest in incoming media exposure or build connections with neighbouring markets.

crowded-sidelines.title: Bring them into the club
crowded-sidelines.body: {{fans, number}} people follow the sport in {{country}}, but only {{hardcore, number}} are hardcore. Turn some of that interest into commitment, or devote the attention to fundraising at the cost of new casual recruitment.

league-under-strain.title: A league under strain
league-under-strain.body: The league in {{country}} was rated {{health}} at the end of the turn. You can regroup at the cost of some hardcore commitment, invest in reaching new fans, or manage the underlying finances from Leagues.

rival-pushback.title: They have noticed
rival-pushback.body: {{rival}} increased its defensive attention in {{country}} during the last turn. Your sport has {{hardcore, number}} hardcore fans here. Challenge that rival's grip, or strengthen your own following.

season-champion.title: Champions of {{country}}
season-champion.body_european: {{champion}} won season {{season}} of the {{country}} league, with {{runnerUp}} runners-up. Another name on the trophy, another chapter in the league's story.
season-champion.body_american: {{champion}} beat {{runnerUp}} in the final to win season {{season}} of the {{country}} league. Another name on the trophy, another chapter in the league's story.

season-foregone.title: A foregone league
season-foregone.body: {{champion}} have now won {{streak}} titles in a row in {{country}}. Casual fans are already drifting away from a result they can predict. A draft lottery would weaken the champions and lift the rest of the field.

season-runaway.title: Runaway champions
season-runaway.body_one: {{champion}} won season {{season}} in {{country}} {{count, number}} point clear of {{runnerUp}}. Casual fans tuned out long before the end. Sharing revenue would strengthen the rest of the field.
season-runaway.body_other: {{champion}} won season {{season}} in {{country}} {{count, number}} points clear of {{runnerUp}}. Casual fans tuned out long before the end. Sharing revenue would strengthen the rest of the field.

choices.hold: Leave the money where it is

season-dynasty.title: A dynasty
season-dynasty.body: {{champion}} have won {{streak}} titles in a row in {{country}}. Celebrate them and the faithful grow, though casual fans tire of a result they can call in advance. Level the field and the champions' supporters will resent it.

season-repeat-final.title: The same two again
season-repeat-final.body_european: For the second season running, {{champion}} and {{runnerUp}} finished first and second in {{country}}, with {{champion}} on top this time. A rivalry is forming. Stoke it and the hardcore will love it, though the league's finances may suffer.
season-repeat-final.body_american: For the second season running, {{champion}} and {{runnerUp}} met in the final in {{country}}, and {{champion}} won it this time. A rivalry is forming. Stoke it and the hardcore will love it, though the league's finances may suffer.

season-underdog.title: Against the odds
season-underdog.body: {{champion}} began season {{season}} among the weakest clubs in {{country}} and finished as champions, ahead of {{runnerUp}}. Ride the story to win new fans, or invest in the club so it can stay competitive.

season-first-title.title: A first title
season-first-title.body: {{champion}} won the first title in their history in season {{season}} in {{country}}, ahead of {{runnerUp}}. Use the moment to reach new people, or reward the supporters who were there before it.

season-close-finish.title: Down to the wire
season-close-finish.body_european_zero: {{champion}} and {{runnerUp}} finished level on points at the top in {{country}}, and {{champion}} took season {{season}} on score difference. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.
season-close-finish.body_european_one: Only {{count, number}} point separated {{champion}} from {{runnerUp}} at the end of season {{season}} in {{country}}. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.
season-close-finish.body_european_other: Only {{count, number}} points separated {{champion}} from {{runnerUp}} at the end of season {{season}} in {{country}}. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.
season-close-finish.body_american: {{champion}} beat {{runnerUp}} in the final of season {{season}} in {{country}} by the narrowest of margins. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.
season-close-finish.body_deciders: The final of season {{season}} in {{country}} finished level and went to deciders, and {{champion}} came through against {{runnerUp}}. Market the finish, or take the gate money while the grounds are full.

summaries.club-grounds: Build a devoted core behind the clubhouse doors.
summaries.fan-meetups: Give your fans a reason to come back.

summaries.border-tournaments: Take the game to the neighbours.

summaries.barnstorming-tours: Trade stability for a place on the road.
summaries.local-radio: Let the conversation cross language communities.
summaries.newspaper-columns: Make your sport part of the morning routine.
summaries.highlight-reels: Give the best moments a bigger audience.
summaries.dubbed-broadcasts: Tell the story in the next market's language.
